text: Miki Jeshurun before you could do it yourself, now is a bit more complicated, because of the id (if u are in A5 this doesn’t apply to u bc u have an actual id) but for b1 an accountant will need to do the “fake id” for you, your partner also if he / she is fluent in hebrew but to be honest, saves time and is not expensive at all (depends on the accountant but mostly between 500-700 sheckels) but yes you can book an appointment in the tax authorities and do it yourself also
